subject.title: fix(approvals): fail closed plugin tool gates

question: Should OpenClaw immediately disable `timeoutBehavior: "allow"` at runtime while retaining the field for one deprecation release train?
rationale: The change closes a tool-execution authority gap but intentionally changes shipped plugin behavior, so code review alone cannot choose the acceptable upgrade policy.

options.title: Accept immediate fail-closed cutover
options.body: Ship strict denial now with the runtime warning, updated documentation, and one release train of type compatibility.

options.title: Add a transition mode
options.body: Temporarily preserve permissive timeout behavior and add an explicit, tested strict mode for migrating plugins.

options.title: Pause for plugin migration
options.body: Delay the runtime cutover until known plugin consumers and release communication are prepared.

recommendation.title: Accept immediate fail-closed cutover
recommendation.body: Ship strict denial now with the runtime warning, updated documentation, and one release train of type compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most recently maintained the durable approval stack and central node-policy path affected by this compatibility and security choice.
